name: @borjie/channel-gateway
description: Unified inbound ChannelEvent canonicalizer (LP-25). Normalizes WhatsApp / SMS / USSD / voice / email / web into one ChannelEvent shape, verifies provider signatures via an injected port, maps sender -> tenant tier, and synchronizes conversation state across channels (WhatsApp 24h window, handoffs) via an injected store. Pure + ports; no direct SDK. Ported + re-skinned from LITFIN core/channels + core/omnichannel.
